prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE polished concept comparison sheet with SIX distinct variants of design A / KEYSTONE from the attached reference. Input image is a design reference, not the layout target. Use ONLY its LEFT column character A / KEYSTONE; explicitly ignore B/C shapes. User selected A and asked 'Make 6 variants on A'. Six different designs, NOT six camera angles of one design.

SHARED KEYSTONE DNA: limb-free floating architect copilot HEAD. Broad top tapering down into a narrower blunt chin, strongly diagonal ivory cheek pillars framing a dark navy trapezoidal face, deep teal faceted rear shell, TWO oversized paired forehead goggles ABOVE the actual face, exactly TWO luminous cyan vertical capsule eyes below the goggles, no mouth. The goggles are dark optical lenses, NOT extra eyes. Tiny orange lower-chin accent, clean architectural side plan emblem where visible. NO body, neck, arms, legs, boots, platforms, dome/sphere head, hardhat, tall compass crest or unrelated gadgets. Preserve friendly thoughtful copilot personality, low-poly chamfered planes, matte ivory/deep-teal/navy/cyan with sparse orange details. Meaningful changes to core frame, cheek construction, brow profile and optics, not merely colors or accessories.

LAYOUT: large landscape 3:2 sheet, preferably 3072x2048 if supported. Three equal columns by two rows. Each cell ONE LARGE front-left three-quarter hero facing page left, SAME camera angle, scale and soft studio lighting, faint hover shadow. Big comfortable margins, models occupy 75% cell height. Navy background with subtle separators. Small top title 'ARCHITECT COPILOT — KEYSTONE VARIANTS'. Under each model exact bold label and one concise phrase given below. No extra marketing text, logos, dimensions, wireframes, palettes, extra inset views or technical claims.

A1 / MONOLITH — 'Solid and composed'. Most faithful development of source A: one continuous thick ivory tapered perimeter, substantial diagonal cheeks, broad flat crown and blunt chin, oversized square beveled goggles integrated closely into brow, substantial dark teal rear wedge. Deliberate solid weight with slightly sharper architectural planes.

A2 / BUTTRESS — 'Strong structural shoulders'. Same tapered head but cheek pillars broaden dramatically at upper corners and step inward twice down to narrow chin, creating stout external buttress-like shoulders. Deep navy face set behind the pillars. Paired goggles are shorter, wider rectangles set inside strong projecting brow ledge. Distinct stepped side silhouette, not round ears.

A3 / TERRACE — 'Layered and inventive'. Same Keystone lower taper with three broad descending roof layers offset rearward, visible stepped roof skyline (integral stacked shell, NOT a hat or buildings). Slimmer cheek pillars formed from two overlapping ivory plates each, open dark seam between layers. Goggles paired chamfered trapezoids, dark teal lens bridge. Compact orange central roof notch, small orange chin.

A4 / PRISM — 'Precise and angular'. More faceted wedge head: broad hexagonal shoulder corners, strongly converging crisp flat cheeks, visibly pentagonal dark face aperture with short flat chin. Two separate hexagonal goggle frames follow the angular brow, large flat facets, deep teal rear diamond-like wedge still broad and friendly. All angles softened by clear chunky bevels. No pointed spear chin or aggressive eyes.

A5 / ATRIUM — 'Light and open'. Preserve broad-to-narrow Keystone outline but each diagonal ivory cheek is a paired structural rib with ONE long genuine open slot between ribs; visible navy background through outer side slots creates airy frame, central face remains opaque and physically supported. Goggles square with large lenses, linked across a wide dark teal upper bridge. Recessed rear shell, small inner chin crosspiece. Open architecture, not detached floating parts. Exactly two side slots overall.

A6 / SURVEYOR — 'Focused and observant'. Wider upper brow and shorter tapered jaw, squat inverted-trapezoid core. Two oversized shallow wide polygonal goggle lenses mounted in an ivory split brow with central V-notch. Outer corner planes swept backward, two diagonal cheek rails meet at a short broad chin beam, dark teal rear housing lower and compact. Lower face a wide friendly trapezoid with cyan capsule eyes. No one-sided cantilever extension, retain balanced A-family symmetry.

Make all SIX obviously related to A but distinct when squinting at the silhouettes. No generic identical helmet repeated with different glasses. Keep front-quarter direction consistent for fair comparison. Number/order top row A1,A2,A3; bottom row A4,A5,A6. High visual polish, concept sculpture feel, easy to review.
